title: Flexit EcoNordic WH4
description: Flexit EcoNordic WH4 heat pump and ventilation unit via wh4-exporter (BACnet/IP).

panels.title: Outdoor
panels.description: Outdoor air temperature (ventilation unit sensor B4).

panels.title: Heat pump
panels.description: Heat pump state (multi-state-input 1).

panels.title: Plant mode
panels.description: What the heat pump system is doing: loading the tank, heating the house from the tank or directly with the heat pump (multi-state-value 40).

panels.title: Alarm
panels.description: Present alarm code per class (A = alarm, B = maintenance). 0 = no alarm. Codes are listed in the Flexit GO manual, e.g. 1020 = replace filter.

panels.title: Heating circuit
panels.description: Space heating flow and return temperature. The setpoint comes from the heating curve.

panels.title: Heating curve vs. actual flow temperature
panels.description: Line: the 7-point heating curve configured in the unit. Dots: measured flow temperature against outdoor temperature over the selected time range.

panels.title: Heating circulation pump
panels.description: Speed of the space heating circulation pump.

panels.title: Mixing valve, tank to heating circuit
panels.description: Storage tank consumer valve (analog-output 26). It mixes hot tank water into the space heating circuit when the house is heated from the tank. With a hot tank and a low flow setpoint it works in the bottom few percent, where small movements give large flow temperature steps. The axis is not fixed at 100 % so these movements stay visible.

panels.title: Operating states
panels.description: Heat pump state, plant mode, hot water state, ventilation mode and operating mode (selects the temperature setpoint). Maintenance functions are at the bottom.

16.text: Load tank & vent.& space with HP

panels.title: Compressor speed
panels.description: Inverter compressor speed feedback.

panels.title: Heat pump water and hot gas
panels.description: Water in/out of the CO2 gas cooler and compressor discharge (hot gas) temperature.

panels.title: Heat pump air side
panels.description: Air entering the heat pump (exhaust air from the ventilation mixed with outdoor air) and the evaporator de-icing sensor.

panels.title: Condenser pump
panels.description: Pump that circulates water from the bottom of the tank through the heat pump's gas cooler and back to the tank. A low flow during loading gives a high outlet temperature in one pass. It may also run while the compressor is off (Forced pump operation).

panels.title: Heat pump fan
panels.description: Fan that draws air through the heat pump's evaporator. It also helps the ventilation unit's extract fan while the heat pump runs.

panels.title: Tank changeover valve
panels.description: Valve that decides where in the tank the water from the heat pump returns.

panels.title: Tank temperatures
panels.description: Hot water tank sensors. In Economy mode the tank is reloaded when the top sensor drops, in Comfort mode when the middle sensor drops.

panels.title: Electric heaters
panels.description: Direct electric heating. The flow-through heater (3 kW) backs up hot water and space heating; the reheater heats the supply air when heat recovery is not enough.

panels.title: Supply air reheater control
panels.description: Heating request from the supply air temperature control to the electric reheater (analog-value 196), its minimum (analog-value 195) and the reheater output signal.

panels.title: Supply air reheater power
panels.description: Electric power of the supply air reheater as calculated by the unit.

panels.title: Reheater energy
panels.description: Supply air reheater energy over the selected time range (average power x time).

panels.title: Reheater avg. power
panels.description: Average supply air reheater power over the selected time range.

panels.title: Air temperatures
panels.description: Extract air is the best available proxy for indoor temperature on the WH4.

panels.title: Air flow
panels.description: Measured air flow and its setpoint. The setpoint changes with the ventilation mode, e.g. Cooker hood lowers extract air because the kitchen hood extracts on its own.

panels.title: Supply air setpoints
panels.description: Measured supply air temperature, the setpoint in use and the setpoint of each operating mode. The operating mode (see Operating states) picks which one applies, so the effective setpoint can be lower than the one set in the app. The Protection setpoint is left out to keep the scale readable.

panels.title: Fan differential pressure
panels.description: Pressure drop across each fan's inlet nozzle. The unit calculates air flow from it as K-factor x sqrt(pressure) (K-factor: analog-value 154 supply, 233 extract). This is not the pressure drop over the filter: the unit holds the air flow constant, so this pressure only changes with the ventilation mode. See Fan speed per air flow for filter clogging.

panels.title: Fan speed per air flow (filter indicator)
panels.description: Fan speed needed per m³/h of air. As a filter clogs, the fan has to spin faster for the same air flow, so this ratio creeps up and drops back when the filter is replaced. Only shown in Home mode, because other modes change the air path. The extract ratio is also hidden while the heat pump compressor runs: the heat pump fan then helps the extract fan and the ratio drops by about 15 %. A temporary rise in both ratios on humid nights around or below 0 °C, together with falling heat recovery efficiency, is frost in the rotary heat exchanger rather than the filter.

panels.title: Operating hours in selected range
panels.description: Increase of the unit's operating hour counters over the dashboard time range. The counters have 1 hour resolution, so short ranges are coarse.

panels.title: Runtime per start
panels.description: Average heat pump runtime per start in the selected range. Short runtimes mean frequent cycling.

panels.title: Filter used
panels.description: Filter operating time relative to the replacement interval.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: 1 if the exporter's last BACnet read succeeded.

panels.title: Maintenance
panels.description: Maintenance functions such as legionella prevention and valve/damper exercise, and the heat pump's service mode. Normally None.
